subject: crs
topic: The baptism, temptation and call of the disciples

kept.q: Who baptized Jesus Christ at the River Jordan?
options: John the Baptist
Philip the Evangelist
Andrew the fisherman
Peter the apostle
kept.explanation: John the Baptist baptized Jesus at the River Jordan, as recorded in Matthew 3:13-17. John had been preaching repentance and baptizing people before Jesus came to him.

kept.q: At the baptism of Jesus in the River Jordan, what came down upon Him from heaven?
options: A pillar of fire
The Holy Spirit like a dove
An angel with a sword
A bright cloud of smoke
kept.explanation: As soon as Jesus came out of the water, the Holy Spirit descended on Him like a dove, confirming His identity as the Son of God. This is recorded in Matthew 3:16.

kept.q: How many days did Jesus fast in the wilderness before the devil came to tempt Him?
options: Twenty days
Thirty days
Forty days
Fifty days
kept.explanation: The Bible records that Jesus fasted for forty days and forty nights in the wilderness before the devil came to tempt Him. This is found in Matthew 4:2.

kept.q: After Jesus' baptism, a voice spoke from heaven. What did the voice declare?
options: "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased"
"This is the prophet greater than Moses"
"This is the king who will rule Israel"
"This is the priest after Melchizedek's order"
kept.explanation: Immediately after the Holy Spirit descended on Jesus, a voice from heaven said, 'This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.' This confirmed God's approval of Jesus before He began His public ministry. See Matthew 3:17.

kept.q: While calling His first disciples by the Sea of Galilee, Jesus found Simon Peter and his brother Andrew doing what?
options: Mending their torn fishing nets
Casting their net into the sea
Selling their catch of fish at the market
Building a new wooden boat
kept.explanation: Jesus saw Simon Peter and Andrew casting their net into the sea, because they were fishermen, and He called them to follow Him. This is recorded in Matthew 4:18.
kept.pidgin: Jesus see Simon Peter and Andrew as dem dey throw dia net inside sea, because na fishermen dem be, and E call dem make dem follow am. Na dis one dey for Matthew 4:18.

kept.q: What promise did Jesus give to Simon Peter and Andrew when He called them to follow Him?
options: "I will make you rulers over Israel"
"I will make you fishers of men"
"I will make you teachers of the law"
"I will make you judges of the twelve tribes"
kept.explanation: Jesus told Peter and Andrew, 'Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men,' meaning they would now lead people to God instead of catching fish. This is in Matthew 4:19.
kept.pidgin: Jesus tell Peter and Andrew say, 'Follow me, I go make una fishers of men,' meaning say dem go dey bring people come God instead of catching fish. Na dis one dey for Matthew 4:19.

kept.q: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, were called by Jesus while they were doing what in their boat?
options: Mending their fishing nets with their father
Teaching the people about the law
Counting money they had collected as tax
Sleeping after a long night of fishing
kept.explanation: Jesus saw James and John in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets, and He called them. They immediately left the boat and their father to follow Jesus. This shows their quick obedience, recorded in Matthew 4:21-22.

q.q: In the wilderness, after Jesus refused to turn stones into bread, the devil took Him to a high place and tempted Him to do what next?
options: Jump down from the pinnacle of the temple
Turn water into wine for the crowd
Build an altar and offer sacrifice
Call down fire from heaven
q.explanation: After the first temptation about bread, the devil took Jesus to the pinnacle of the temple and told Him to throw Himself down, tempting Him to test God's protection. Jesus refused, quoting Scripture. This order is recorded in Matthew 4:5-7.
